subject.title: fix(ci): accept valid Kova PASS records without violations

question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrow Kova report-gate tolerance for PASS records that omit `violations` after refreshing the draft branch against current main?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes release-gate automation semantics and the live PR is maintainer-labeled, draft, and behind current main, so cleanup automation should not make the merge decision.

options.title: Accept After Current-Head Proof
options.body: Refresh the branch or otherwise prove the exact merge head, then merge if the positive omitted-violations cases and fail-closed cases still pass.

options.title: Require Stronger Kova Contract Proof
options.body: Ask for a direct Kova schema/source or captured-report proof that `violations` is optional on PASS records before accepting the helper tolerance.

options.title: Keep The Gate Strict
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers want Kova to always emit `violations: []` rather than accepting omitted PASS fields in OpenClaw's adapter.

recommendation.title: Accept After Current-Head Proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch or otherwise prove the exact merge head, then merge if the positive omitted-violations cases and fail-closed cases still pass.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the recent Kova report-gate helper history and authored both the merged predecessor and this focused follow-up.
